title: Schilpario to Passo del Vivione
coachNotes: Close to free training from an ITB standpoint: 893m up against only 211m down. This is a power hike, not a stroll, so push a real effort on the climb, but do not turn it into a race. Poles from the trailhead, they cost you nothing today and build the habit for Sunday. This 893m is now counted inside weekendDplus (2278m total for the Fri-Sun block), so the site's ramp check sees the true vertical. Garmin target 70-90. Eat and drink properly on arrival, Saturday is the big one.
